## Environment

- macOS desktop session and Python 3.10 or newer.
- Connect IQ SDK 9.3.0 or newer with the fēnix 8 47 mm profile (`fenix847mm`).
- Private companion source at `~/src/garmin-voicenotes-companion`, or set `VOICENOTES_COMPANION_DIR`.
- JDK 11 or newer, Android build-tools 36.0.0, platform `android-37.0`, and ADB. Set `ANDROID_HOME` or `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT` if needed.
- Default AVD `Medium_Phone_API_37.0`. Keep port 8787 free during tests.

## Recipes

| Recipe | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `just garmin-run-fixture` | Loads the watch fixture for the manual demo. |
| `just android-build` | Builds `bin/android/Voicenotes-debug.apk`. |
| `just android-emulator [avd]` | Boots the selected virtual phone. |
| `just test-simulator [serial]` | Requires foreground delivery and reconnect recovery. Records background delivery. |
| `just test-simulator-background [serial]` | Also requires delivery with the watch app closed. |

The suite uses a fresh `VNE2E` watch app and `bin/android/Voicenotes-test.apk` (`ch.voicenotes.inbox.e2e`). The host tether uses port 7381 and the emulator inbox uses 17381. The runner restores an existing direct ADB forward for the selected emulator.

## Assertions and artifacts

| Check | Expected result |
| --- | --- |
| Foreground | Watch receipt and matching WAV hash. |
| Reconnect | The restarted inbox resumes at the saved offset and produces one WAV per note ID. |
| Watch app closed | The runner checks for delivery within 25 seconds of an Android sync request and verifies delivery after reopening. |

The 32,044-byte WAV has SHA-256 `953ea453dce7245c7e2153012000d3bf686cee2b75cc6d30f60da90812b64022`. Logs, WAVs, and `background.txt` are saved in `.tools/simulator-tests/<run>/`.

[Garmin simulator connection guide](https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/articles/core-topics/Communicating_with_Mobile_Apps.html)
